Read TODO.md and pick exactly ONE unchecked item that is small, concretely
specified, and implementable end to end in a single change. Prefer an item that
closes a stated gap in existing code over one that starts a new subsystem.

Then implement it properly:

- Make the smallest change that fully satisfies the item.
- Add tests that fail without your change and pass with it.
- Follow the conventions already present in the files you edit.
- Do not weaken, skip, or disable any existing test or check.
- Do not reformat, rename, or refactor anything the item does not require.
- If the item turns out to be larger than one change, implement the
  self-contained part of it and say plainly in your summary what remains.

Update TODO.md to reflect exactly what you did. Mark the item done only if it is
genuinely complete; if it is not, say what is still missing rather than implying
it is finished.
